title: The dualizing sheaf restricts to a rational tail with negative degree
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the restriction of the dualizing sheaf to a rational tail has strictly negative degree (statement lines 5986-5992). The proof (lines 5994-6007) runs an actual degree computation inside the span: the conductor exact sequence from the nodal-subscheme lemmas, the identification of the tail with P^1 over the extension field k' giving deg(omega_C) = -2[k' : k], the intersection degree [k' : k], and the additive conclusion deg(omega_X|_C) = -[k' : k] < 0. H2: compact, but the degree bookkeeping is the argument and it feeds the rational-tail contraction results that the stable-model section is built on.
